postReview.title: Newcastle United 0-1 Everton: Barry bags again as Moyes' men triumph at St James' Park
postReview.description: Everton won at St James' Park for the third season running as they ended their wait for an away victory in the Premier League this term.

postReview.title: Newcastle United 0-1 Everton: Barry vuelve a marcar y el equipo de Moyes triunfa en St James' Park
postReview.description: El Everton ganó en St James' Park por tercera temporada consecutiva y logró su primera victoria a domicilio en esta Premier League.
